Description:en: Indicates the original clinical note or encounter to which this addendum applies.
Indicates that the addendum supplements the patient's admission note.
Indicates that the addendum supplements a consultant review note.
Indicates that the addendum supplements a patient's progress note.
Indicates that the addendum supplements a ward round note.
Indicates that the addendum supplements a nursing note.
Indicates that the addendum supplements an operative (surgical) note.
Indicates that the addendum supplements a procedure note documenting a clinical or surgical procedure.
Indicates that the addendum supplements the patient's discharge summary.
Additional relevant patient history not captured elsewhere in the clinical note.
Additional physical examination findings not documented in the standard examination sections.

Fully specified name:en: DID THIS NEW INFORMATION CHANGE DIAGNOSIS
Description:en: Indicates whether the information documented in the addendum resulted in a change to the patient's diagnosis.
Records the diagnosis documented before the addendum or revision.
Records the updated or revised diagnosis following the clinical addendum.
Records any medication additions, discontinuations, dose adjustments, substitutions, or other changes resulting from the addendum.
Records recommendations made by the consulting specialist as part of the clinical addendum, including investigations, treatment, referrals, follow-up, and other management advice.
Records any isolation precautions or infection prevention measures required for the patient following the clinical addendum.
Records instructions for ongoing patient monitoring following the clinical addendum, including observations, vital signs, laboratory monitoring, and clinical review requirements.
Records the reason or clinical details explaining the patient's deterioration.
Indicates whether the patient was informed about the clinical findings, diagnosis, treatment changes, or recommendations documented in the addendum.
Indicates whether the patient's next of kin was informed about the clinical findings, diagnosis, treatment changes, or recommendations documented in the addendum.
Indicates whether the responsible consultant was informed about the clinical findings, diagnosis, treatment changes, or recommendations documented in the addendum.
Records the investigations or diagnostic tests that should be repeated following the clinical addendum.
